mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in the INDPRO index, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y INDPRO growth drops by > 4pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the federal funds rate by more than 50 basis points in one month signals an abrupt shift to a tightening monetary policy regime, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises by > 75bp in a month but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the housing starts series (HOUST) is rising and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is falling, it signals a strong consumer demand environment that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST rising and UNRATE falling, but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 7% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) is falling, it signals a weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending slows.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 7% and PAYEMS falling, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it signals a restrictive monetary policy environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL rising, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP (GDPC1) growth accelerating by more than 3% year-over-year signals a strong demand environment that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth > 3% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.
